checks.check: authority ownership and prerequisite fail-closed behavior
checks.basis: Spec §1 (lines 41-63) and ADR-0081:62-76 keep M9 out of M8 promotion, Canon/Narrative, Factual and credential authority. Execution contract required_acceptance (lines 21-47) plus packet_release_acceptance M9-D (176-184) gate FA-1 at M9-D only, and M9-A A0 preflight routing (packet:37-46) fails closed. The seams the design names exist at V2: CurrentUserInfo.id/sub and get_current_interactive_user (server/auth.py:37-41,459-489), and CurrentShowrunnerGrantReader/GrantScopeV1 (server/services/governance_grants.py:238, r2/governance/grant_transition.py:13).

checks.check: contract fields, digest domains and cohort isolation
checks.basis: §§4-7 freeze extra-forbid models over the real M8ContractModel/CanonicalJsonObject/Sha256Digest (r2/contracts/advanced_creative.py:74,104,139). The §8 table (spec:1303-1334) assigns a domain tag to every authority digest. Cohort isolation binds the exact profile identity, revision and digest everywhere, and checks M8 entries against creative_profile_id/version (spec:1314,1561-1564; A1.5 restricts the value to WESTERN_GENERIC, CN_SHORT_DRAMA_SHUANGWEN or arcreel.host, which match r2/advanced_creative/lineage.py:21-54). The remaining gaps are digest-completeness polish (notes).

checks.check: exact command replay, concurrent-first-call serialization, CAS and lock order
checks.basis: Spec §9 steps 1-6 (1363-1387) define receipt preflight, external I/O outside the transaction, a pg_advisory_xact_lock command-key guard with a full-key reread, and atomic commit. Acquire binds its attempt to the full command key (1466-1473). CAS uses current_revision plus head_version (1421-1425), and the global lock rank 1-11 with 1a shared/exclusive invalidation guard (1427-1454) is acyclic. M9-A A2.2/A2.4/A3.4 (packet:219,229,253) test winner/loser and collision serialization.

checks.check: custodian authorization lease subject, policy, replay and admission deadline
checks.basis: The CustodianAuthorizationLease (spec:410-419) and the profile, Greenlight and invalidation subject digests (1318-1324) bind command and subject. The host adapter (1389-1419) fixes policy id/version to arcreel.showrunner-grant / governance.showrunner_grant_event.v1 (matching r2/governance/ceremony.py:194), and evidence to the grant event digest. Durable host_custodian_leases replay is unique on (user, project, actor, operation, command), and admit_not_after is at most 30 s and never past grant expires_at. The deliberate in-window revocation trade-off is stated. Expired unadmitted leases are not refreshed.

checks.check: provider capability, retention, deletion and unknown-outcome boundaries
checks.basis: CONDITIONAL/FORBIDDEN semantics and effective evaluation are covered (spec:860-870). Read-time retention enforcement, revocation detection and the sweep are covered (872-890). Attempt transitions are monotonic, and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN is never converted to a known failure (1481-1515). Adapters stay dormant or unavailable (§15:1797-1809). Payload deletion uses delete_exact behind opaque refs, with only permitted proofs retained (1336-1355,1701-1727).

The seed is server-side through ExplorationService.append_revision, never the client route (spec:1590-1644; ADR-0107/0109). The service exists with exact command replay and a caller-frozen created_at (r2/advanced_creative/exploration.py:204-225; lib/db/repositories/advanced_creative.py:232-262). CanvasNode.node_type is str (contracts:158-161), the master is null, and there is no promotion. The Factual bridge stores only refs/digests, and Greenlight cannot elevate a claim (1652-1664).

Traversal, fixpoint propagation, the deadline and NEEDS_OPERATOR are defined (spec:1666-1740). However, the normative public reader get_greenlight returns a bare GreenlightDecision with no EvidenceValidityProjection (spec:89), although §1:49, §2:99-101 and §6:1028-1033 require an invalidated Greenlight's projection to be readable. An invalidated APPROVE is therefore indistinguishable on read.

checks.check: packet state, A0 boundary, stop-code and artifact synchronization
checks.basis: Packet state and the A0 boundary are consistent (spec:58-63, umbrella:23,106-110, packet:21-33, execution contract execution_policy). Bound hashes recompute: the schema, review schema, verifier and tests match execution contract lines 25-33, and the 21 verifier tests pass. But spec §9 rank 1a (1430-1440) requires M9-B/C/D transactions to refuse inputs covered by a non-COMPLETE invalidation job, while the job table arrives only in migration 9e9c4a0e0001 (umbrella:90). Umbrella Task E 'Create/modify only' (umbrella:198) excludes the acquisition, signal, candidate, Greenlight and bridge modules that must perform that refusal.

checks.check: donor behavioral parity excluding all license questions by sponsor direction
checks.basis: Donor pins and paths match across the execution contract (lines 82-110) and the research doc (lines 13-15,181,216). The parity protocol (spec §21:1964-1976) requires exact-pin same-fixture PARITY/IMPROVED, with donor-defect fixtures and recomputation by the verifier. M9-A A1.3/A1.5 and M9_DONOR_PARITY_INCOMPLETE routing make it executable. License questions are explicitly excluded.

checks.check: operational envelope, accessibility and executable evidence requirements
checks.basis: Spec §16 (1811-1834) fixes hard ceilings, failure behavior and benchmark metrics. §17 (1836-1856) requires i18n for en/vi/zh (matching frontend/src/i18n and lib/i18n) and Playwright+axe across the named states. Umbrella Task F and M9-A A4 (packet:267-296) require explicit commands, logs, counts and empty skips/unknowns. The design-acceptance verifier is Git-backed and its tests pass (21 passed).

blocking_findings.check: packet state, A0 boundary, stop-code and artifact synchronization
blocking_findings.issue: Spec §9 rank 1a (spec:1430-1440) and §13 (spec:1694-1722) require acquisition finalize, signal derivation, candidate append, decide_greenlight, seed_canvas and submit_factual_evidence to take the shared invalidation guard, refuse inputs covered by a non-COMPLETE job (M9_INVALIDATION_INCOMPLETE), and fail operational use of invalidated evidence (M9_EVIDENCE_STALE). The job/edge/projection tables are created only by M9-E migration 9e9c4a0e0001 (umbrella:90), so M9-B/C/D cannot implement the check. Task E's file allowlist ('Create/modify only invalidation.py, M9-E persistence/indexes, evidence-store deletion adapter, read projections...') excludes acquisition.py, signals.py, candidates.py, greenlight.py and bridges.py, where the refusal must run. The B-D stop-code rows also omit M9_INVALIDATION_INCOMPLETE. An E packet author must either break the allowlist or leave the guarantee unimplemented.
blocking_findings.fix: Choose one placement and state it in both the umbrella and the spec. Either (a) Task E explicitly owns the guard/coverage call sites in acquisition.py, signals.py, candidates.py, greenlight.py and bridges.py, plus their regression tests; or (b) the job table and an empty coverage check move into an earlier migration and packet, with the codes added to the B/C/D routing rows.

blocking_findings.issue: OpportunityIntelligenceReader.get_greenlight returns GreenlightDecision | None. Snapshots and candidates are returned as *View types carrying EvidenceValidityProjection (spec:1005-1011), but Greenlight has no view type. §1:49 makes the 'current validity projection' of a Greenlight M9-owned, §2:99-101 says historical reads return any applicable validity projection, and §6:1028-1033 says invalidation changes only the decision's projection (no new decision is appended). Public signatures are normative (umbrella:78), so a reader cannot express an INVALIDATED APPROVE: it would either serve a bare APPROVE (misleading the Greenlight UI in §17) or need an M9_SCHEMA_CHANGE_REQUIRED amendment.
blocking_findings.fix: Add a frozen GreenlightDecisionView(decision: GreenlightDecision, validity: EvidenceValidityProjection), change get_greenlight to return GreenlightDecisionView | None, and state that during incomplete propagation it returns M9_INVALIDATION_INCOMPLETE, as snapshot and candidate reads do.

non_blocking_notes: M8LearningEvidenceEntry.state (spec:460) uses CURRENT/SUPERSEDED/DISPOSED, but the mapping from the accepted M8 records is not spelled out. Those records are LearningObservation.correction_of, LearningRecommendation.expires_at and RecommendationDecision with ACCEPT/REJECT/DEFER/REQUEST_EXPERIMENT. It is unclear whether every disposition (including ACCEPT) means DISPOSED and triggers IntakeM8Correction invalidation, and DECISION entries must derive creative_profile from the recommendation lineage. Define this in the M9-C packet.
§5 line 886 says the sweep creates InvalidationJob(reason=RETENTION_DEADLINE | GRANT_REVOKED), but the origin enum value is RETENTION_SWEEP (spec:803-807,1674). Align the wording.

SweepRetention derives command_id as digest(snapshot_id, deadline) (spec:1159,1674), which conflicts with 'All IDs are repository-standard UUIDv7 strings' (spec:173). IntakeM8Correction has no explicit command_id or receipt-key rule. The 'deadline' component for GRANT_REVOKED jobs is unspecified.

No §8 domain is defined for InvalidationJob/Receipt.dependency_closure_digest, BridgeIntent.closure_digest/request_digest, M8LearningEvidenceBundle.evidence_closure_digest (it is also not listed as port-owned), AcquisitionAttempt.page_cursor_digest or SnapshotPage cursor digests.

Spec §13 line 1696-1697: 'a seed or factual record that was nevertheless created is recorded as stale and invalidated through its port'. M8CanvasSeedPort has no invalidate operation and Canvas history is immutable (ADR-0081:116-118), so the sentence should apply port invalidation to Factual only.

§9 M9 receipt key (user_id, actor_id, operation, command_id) omits project_name, while host_custodian_leases and the M8 command keys include it. In V2, get_current_interactive_user always returns id=DEFAULT_USER_ID, so the same command_id across projects becomes a replay conflict rather than a separate command. That is safe, but state it explicitly.

The M9-A persistence map (packet:128) lists host_custodian_leases columns without 'operation', though its unique key includes operation. Lease validation in §7.1 (spec:1288-1292) names only profile and Greenlight leases; the invalidation lease is covered only via §13. host_custodian_leases is host-owned but created and dropped by the M9 migration chain; record that downgrade coupling.

The PENDING->DISPATCHED bridge-intent transition is not explicitly listed among the shared-invalidation-guard transactions (spec:1433-1436). The CAS race with CANCELLED_BY_INVALIDATION is covered by reconciliation, but stating the guard would simplify proof.

M9 admits leases without rechecking the ADR-0103 grant inside its own transaction (spec:1406-1411). This is a documented, bounded deviation from ADR-0103's same-transaction grant checks. Reviewers of M9-A should confirm the composed reader is the CheckpointedShowrunnerGrantReader built in server/services/governance_startup.py.
The verifier does not recheck the base_review_contract sha256/status named in the M9 contract (contract lines 5-9). That hash currently matches (047551f6...).

ExplorationService.append_revision requires candidate.created_by == user_id (r2/advanced_creative/exploration.py:213). The frozen seed revision's created_by should be specified as user_id (the data owner), not actor_id.
